watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: #Winter air makes #menopause #skin feel even drier. A creamy shea butter bar turns a warm-water hand wash into a small ritual she will look forward to. #soap #gifts #giftsforher

watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Menopause can change how your mouth feels, from sensitive gums to dryness. A soft-bristle electric brush with a pressure sensor is a quiet, practical gift she will use daily. #gifts #giftideas #giftsforher

drafts_today.text:
Want glass skin after 40? You don't get it by adding another bottle.

Hydration in, barrier supported, a cream sealed onto damp skin. That's the glow. My night finishes with RIMAN, not a 10-step pile-up.

Save this for tonight if your skin has been looking tired. #GlassSkin #Over40
drafts_today.video_tip: 12 seconds: pat a little water onto your face, press in your RIMAN cream, then turn toward a window so the damp-skin glow shows. On-screen text: "Glow from hydration, not more bottles."

drafts_today.text:
If the internet told you that over 40 you need a 10-step routine, you can ignore that.

Your skin wants consistency, not a crowded shelf. I use three: a gentle cleanse, hydration on damp skin, and RIMAN cream to seal it in. That's enough for a good Monday.

What's the one product you actually reach for every night? #SkincareOver40 #SkinBarrier
drafts_today.video_tip: 12 seconds: slow pan across a simple three-product tray (cleanser, hydrator, RIMAN), then pick up just those three. On-screen text: "Three steps. That's the routine."

drafts_today.text:
Sunday night is a good time to give winter-dry skin a reset.

If your face has felt tight or a little itchy this week, skip the extra actives tonight. Warm rinse, hydration while your skin is still damp, then a richer RIMAN cream pressed in slowly. Wake up softer, not busy.

Who's resetting with me tonight? #WinterSkin #MenopauseSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 15 seconds: Sunday-evening bathroom, a warm splash or cloth, then a slow press of RIMAN cream. On-screen text: "Sunday night: reset, don't pile on."
